reason: A mobile-focused DeepSeek Harness UI plugin that adds responsive drawers, touch controls, PWA installation support, and optional notifications for completed agent tasks.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web Shell 提供面向手机的响应式布局、抽屉导航、PWA 安装体验和任务完成通知。
summaries.en: Adds a touch-oriented mobile layout, drawer navigation, PWA installation support, and optional task-completion notifications to the DeepSeek Harness Web Shell.

capabilities: Transforms the host web interface into a touch-oriented mobile layout below 768px
Provides PWA manifest, icons, installation guidance, and a service worker
Sends web push notifications after the host reports successful agent completion
Stores and uses configured VAPID credentials and push subscriptions
